verses.translation: But Nicanor, hearing that Judas and his company were in the strong places about Samaria, resolved without any danger to set upon them on the sabbath day.

translations.ron: Iar Nicanor, aflând că cei care erau cu Iuda sunt în locurile cele dimprejurul Samariei, a făcut sfat, ca în ziua de odihnă, fără nici o frică, să meargă cu război împotriva lor.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ Νικάνωρ μεταλαβὼν τοὺς περὶ τὸν Ἰούδαν ὄντας ἐν τοῖς κατὰ Σαμάρειαν τόποις, ἐβουλεύσατο τῇ τῆς καταπαύσεως ἡμέρᾳ μετὰ πάσης ἀσφαλείας αὐτοῖς ἐπιβαλεῖν.

verses.translation: Nevertheless the Jews that were compelled to go with him said, O destroy not so cruelly and barbarously, but give honour to that day, which he, that seeth all things, hath honoured with holiness above other days.

translations.ron: Ci Evreii, care de nevoie mergeau cu Nicanor, ziceau: "Să nu-i pierzi nicidecum aşa sălbatic şi barbar, ci cinsteşte ziua pe care mai înainte a sfinţit-o şi a cinstit-o Cel care vede toate".
translations.grk: Τῶν δὲ κατʼ ἀνάγκην συνεπομένων αὐτῷ Ἰουδαίων, λεγόντων, μηδαμῶς οὕτως ἀγρίως καὶ βαρβάρως ἀπολέσῃς, δόξαν δὲ ἀπομέρισον τῇ προτετιμημένῃ ὑπὸ τοῦ πάντα ἐθορῶντος μεθʼ ἁγιότητος ἡμέρᾳ.

verses.translation: Then the most ungracious wretch demanded, if there were a Mighty one in heaven, that had commanded the sabbath day to be kept.

translations.ron: Iar de trei ori nelegiuitul acela păgân a întrebat: "Oare este în cer Puternic, care să fi poruncit a se ţine ziua de odihnă?"
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ τρισαλιτήριος ἐπηρώτησεν, εἰ ἔστιν ἐν οὐρανῷ δυνάστης ὁ προστεταχὼς ἄγειν τὴν τῶν σαββάτων ἡμέραν;

verses.translation: And when they said, There is in heaven a living Lord, and mighty, who commanded the seventh day to be kept:

translations.ron: Şi ei, răspunzând, au zis: "Domnul cel viu, Acela este puternicul Cel din cer, Care a poruncit să nu se lucreze în ziua a şaptea".
translations.grk: Τῶν δὲ ἀποφῃναμένων, ἔστιν ὁ Κύριος ζῶν αὐτὸς ἐν οὐρανῷ δυνάστης, ὁ κελεύσας ἀσκεῖν τὴν ἑβδομάδα.

verses.translation: then said the other, And I also am mighty upon earth, and I command to take arms, and to do the king's business. Yet he obtained not to have his wicked will done.

translations.ron: Iar celălalt a zis: "Şi eu sunt puternic pe pământ, care poruncesc a lua arme şi a plini lucrurile regelui". Însă n-a ajuns să-şi poată împlini sfatul său nelegiuit.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ ἕτερος, κᾀγώ φησι, δυνάστης ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὁ προστάσσων αἴρειν ὅπλα, καὶ τὰς βασιλικὰς χρείας ἐπιτελεῖν· ὅμως οὐ κατέσχεν ἐπιτελέσαι τό σχέτλιον αὐτοῦ βούλημα.

verses.translation: So Nicanor in exceeding pride and haughtiness determined to set up a public monument of his victory over Judas and them that were with him.

translations.ron: Deci Nicanor, cu toată semeţia, înălţându-se, socotea să facă biruinţă de pomină asupra lui Iuda.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ μὲν Νικάνωρ μετὰ πάσης ἀλαζονείας ὑψαυχενῶν, διεγνώκει κοινὸν τῶν περὶ τὸν Ἰούδαν συστήσασθαι τρόπαιον.

verses.translation: But Maccabeus had ever sure confidence that the Lord would help him:

translations.ron: Dar Iuda Macabeul neîncetat, cu toată nădejdea, credea că va avea ajutor de la Domnul.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ Μακκαβαῖος ἦν ἀδιαλείπτως πεποιθὼς μετὰ πάσης ἐλπίδος ἀντιλήψεως τεύξασθαι παρὰ τοῦ Κυρίου.

verses.translation: wherefore he exhorted his people not to fear the coming of the heathen against them, but to remember the help which in former times they had received from heaven, and now to expect the victory and aid, which should come unto them from the Almighty.

translations.ron: Şi îndemna pe cei care erau cu sine să nu se sperie de venirea neamurilor, ci aducându-şi aminte de ajutoarele cele de mai înainte, care li s-au făcut din cer şi acum să aştepte de la Cel Atotputernic biruinţă şi ajutor.
translations.grk: Καὶ παρεκάλει τοὺς σὺν αὐτῷ μὴ δειλιᾷν τὴν τῶν ἔθνῶν ἔφοδον, ἔχοντας δὲ κατὰ νοῦν τὰ προγεγονότα αὐτοῖς ἁπʼ οὐρανοῦ βοηθήματα, καὶ τανῦν προσδοκᾷν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ παντοκράτορος ἐσομένην αὐτοῖς νίκην καὶ βοήθειαν.

verses.translation: And so comforting them out of the law and the prophets, and withal putting them in mind of the battles that they won afore, he made them more cheerful.

translations.ron: Şi-i mângâia din lege şi din prooroci şi aducându-le aminte de războaiele pe care mai înainte le-au purtat, mai cu osârdie i-a îmbărbătat.
translations.grk: Καὶ παραμυθούμενος αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν, προσυπομνήσας δὲ αὐτοὺς καὶ τοὺς ἀγῶνας οὓς ἦσαν ἐκτετελεκότες, προθυμοτέρους αὐτοὺς κατέστησε.

verses.translation: And when he had stirred up their minds, he gave them their charge, shewing them therewithal the falsehood of the heathen, and the breach of oaths.

translations.ron: Şi aşa întărâtându-i cu mânie, împreună le-a arătat că neamurile n-au ţinut alianţa şi au călcat jurământul.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς θυμοῖς διεγείρας αὐτοὺς, παρήγγειλεν, ἅμα παρεπιδεικνὺς τὴν τῶν ἐθνῶν ἀθεσίαν καὶ τὴν τῶν ὅρκων παράβασιν.

verses.translation: Thus he armed every one of them, not so much with defence of shields and spears, as with comfortable and good words: and beside that, he told them a dream worthy to be believed, as if it had been so indeed, which did not a little rejoice them.

translations.ron: Şi pe fiecare dintr-înşii nu atât cu scuturi şi cu arme îi întărea, cât fi îndemna cu cuvinte foarte bune, iar la urmă le-a spus şi un vis vrednic de credinţă, prin care pe toţi i-a făcut voioşi.
translations.grk: Ἕκαστον δὲ αὐτῶν καθοπλίσας, οὐ τὴν ἀσπίδων καὶ λογχῶν ἀσφάλειαν, ὡς τὴν ἐν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς λόγοις παράκλησιν, καὶ προσεξηγησάμενος ὄνειρον ἀξιόπιστον ὕπαρ τι πάντας εὔφρανεν.

verses.translation: And this was his vision: That Onias, who had been high priest, a virtuous and a good man, reverend in conversation, gentle in condition, well spoken also, and exercised from a child in all points of virtue, holding up his hands prayed for the whole body of the Jews.

translations.ron: Iar vederea visului astfel era: că Onia, care fusese arhiereu, om bun, blând, cucernic la chip şi cu obiceiuri bune şi la vorbă cuvios, care din pruncie s-a nevoit întru toate lucrurile faptei bune, cu mâinile întinse se ruga pentru toată adunarea Evreilor.
translations.grk: Ἦν δὲ ἡ τούτου θεωρία τοιάδε· Ὀνίαν τὸν γενόμενον ἀρχιερέα, ἄνδρα καλὸν καὶ ἀγαθὸν, αἰδήμονα μὲν τὴν ἀπάντησιν, πρᾷον δὲ τὸν τρόπον, καὶ λαλιὰν προϊέμενον πρεπόντως, καὶ ἐκ παιδὸς ἐκμεμελετηκότα πάντα τὰ τῆς ἀρετῆς οἰκεῖα, τοῦτον τὰς χεῖρας προτείναντα κατεύχεσθαι τῷ παντὶ τῶν Ἰουδαίων συστήματι.

verses.translation: This done, in like manner there appeared a man with gray hairs, and exceeding glorious, who was of a wonderful and excellent majesty.

translations.ron: După aceasta s-a arătat un bărbat cu cărunteţe §i cu slavă minunată şi preacuvioasă mărire era împrejurul lui.
translations.grk: Εἶθʼ οὕτως ἐπιφανῆναι ἄνδρα πολιᾷ καὶ δόξῃ διαφέροντα, θαυμαστὴν δέ τινα καὶ μεγαλοπρεπεστάτην εἶναι τὴν περὶ αὐτὸν ὑπεροχήν.

verses.translation: Then Onias answered, saying, This is a lover of the brethren, who prayeth much for the people, and for the holy city, to wit, Jeremias the prophet of God.

translations.ron: Şi a grăit Onia, zicând către Iuda: Acesta este iubitorul de fraţi, proorocul lui Dumnezeu Ieremia, care mult se roagă pentru popor şi pentru sfânta cetate.
translations.grk: Ἀποκριθέντα δὲ τὸν Ὀνιαν εἰπεῖν, ὁ φιλάδελφος οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πολλὰ προσευχόμενος περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ τῆς ἁγίας πόλεως, Ἱερεμίας ὁ τοῦ Θεοῦ προφήτης.

verses.translation: Whereupon Jeremias holding forth his right hand gave to Judas a sword of gold, and in giving it spake thus,

translations.ron: Iar Ieremia a întins dreapta şi a dat lui Iuda sabia de aur şi i-a zis acestea:
translations.grk: Προτείναντα δὲ τὸν Ἱερεμίαν τὴν δεξιὰν παραδοῦναι τῷ Ἰούδᾳ ῥομφαίαν χρυσῆν, διδόντα δὲ προσφωνῆσαι τάδε,

verses.translation: Take this holy sword, a gift from God, with the which thou shalt wound the adversaries.

translations.ron: Ia această sfântă sabie, care este dar de la Dumnezeu, prin care vei surpa pe vrăjmaşi.
translations.grk: λάβε τὴν ἁγίαν ῥομφαίαν δῶρον παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ, διʼ ἧς θραύσεις τοὺς ὑπεναντίους.

verses.translation: Thus being well comforted by the words of Judas, which were very good, and able to stir them up to valour, and to encourage the hearts of the young men, they determined not to pitch camp, but courageously to set upon them, and manfully to try the matter by conflict, because the city and the sanctuary and the temple were in danger.

translations.ron: Deci mângâindu-se cu aceste cuvinte foarte bune ale lui Iuda, care putea aprinde inimile voinicilor şi spre vitejie a le îmbărbăta, a socotit să nu tabere, ci vitejeşte să năvălească şi bărbăteşte să se apuce şi să se bată, ca să se aleagă lucrul; pentru că şi cetatea şi sfintele şi templul Domnului erau în primejdie.
translations.grk: Παρακληθέντες δὲ τοῖς Ἰούδα λόγοις πάνυ καλοῖς καὶ δυναμένοις ἐπʼ ἀρετὴν παρορμῆσαι, καὶ ψυχὰς νέων ἐπανορθῶσαι, διέγνωσαν μὴ στρατοπεδεύεσθαι, γενναίως δὲ ἐμφέρεσθαι, καὶ μετὰ πάσης εὐανδρίας ἐμπλακέντες κρῖναι τὰ πράγματα, διὰ τὸ καὶ τὴν πόλιν, καὶ τὰ ἅγια, καὶ τὸ ἱερὸν κινδυνεύειν.

verses.translation: For the care that they took for their wives, and their children, their brethren, and kinsfolks, was in least account with them: but the greatest and principal fear was for the holy temple.

translations.ron: Iar de femei şi de prunci şi de fraţi şi de rudenii mai puţină grijă aveau; frica cea mai mare şi cea mai dintâi le era pentru sfântul locaş.
translations.grk: Ἦν γὰρ ὁ περὶ γυναικῶν καὶ τέκνων, ἔτι δὲ ἀδελφῶν καὶ συγγενῶν ἐν ἥττονι μέρει κείμενος αὐτοῖς ἀγὼν, μέγιστος δὲ καὶ πρῶτος ὁ περὶ τοῦ καθηγιασμένου ναοῦ φόβος.

verses.translation: Also they that were in the city took not the least care, being troubled for the conflict abroad.

translations.ron: Însă cei care erau în cetate, foarte îngrijoraţi erau şi tulburaţi pentru cei care aveau să poarte războiul.
translations.grk: Ἦν δὲ καὶ τοῖς ἐν τῇ πόλει κατειλημμένοις οὐ πάρεργος ἀγωνία ταρασσομένοις τῆς ἐν ὑπαίθρῳ προσβολῆς.

verses.translation: And now, when as all looked what should be the trial, and the enemies were already come near, and the army was set in array, and the beasts conveniently placed, and the horsemen set in wings,

translations.ron: Şi toţi aşteptau acum sfârşitul apropiat, fiindcă se apropiaseră vrăjmaşii şi îşi aşezară armata în linie de bătaie, îşi puseseră elefanţii la loc bun şi împărţiseră călărimea la dreapta şi la stânga.
translations.grk: Καὶ πάντων ἤδη προσδοκώντων τὴν ἐσομένην κρίσιν, καὶ ἤδη συμμιξάντων τῶν πολεμίων, καὶ τῆς στρατιᾶς ἐκταγείσης, καὶ τῶν θηρίων ἐπὶ μέρος εὔκαιρον ἀποκατασταθέντων, τῆς τε ἵππου κατὰ κέρας τεταγμένης,

verses.translation: Maccabeus seeing the coming of the multitude, and the divers preparations of armour, and the fierceness of the beasts, stretched out his hands toward heaven, and called upon the Lord that worketh wonders, knowing that victory cometh not by arms, but even as it seemeth good to him, he giveth it to such as are worthy:

translations.ron: Iar Macabeu, văzând venirea oştirii şi gătirea armelor cea de multe feluri şi sălbăticiunea elefanţilor, a întins mâinile spre cer şi s-a rugat Domnului şi păzitorului Celui care face minuni, cunoscând că nu în arme este biruinţa, ci, precum El Însuşi judecă, dă celor vrednici biruinţă.
translations.grk: Συνιδὼν ὁ Μακκαβαῖος τὴν τῶν πληθῶν παρουσίαν, καὶ τῶν ὅπλων τὴν ποικίλην παρασκευὴν, τήν τε τῶν θηρίων ἀγριότητα, προτείνας τὰς χεῖρας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν, ἐπεκαλέσατο τὸν τερατοποιὸν Κύριον τὸν κατόπτην, γινώσκων ὅτι οὐκ ἔστι διʼ ὅπλων ἡ νίκη, καθὼς δὲ ἂν αὐτῷ κριθείη, τοῖς ἀξίοις περιποιεῖται τὴν νίκην.

verses.translation: therefore in his prayer he said after this manner: O Lord, thou didst send thine angel in the time of Ezekias king of Judea, and didst slay in the host of Sennacherib an hundred fourscore and five thousand:

translations.ron: Şi rugându-se, aşa a zis: "Tu, Doamne, ai trimis pe îngerul Tău în zilele lui Iezechia, regele lui Iuda, şi a ucis din tabăra lui Sanherib ca la o sută optzeci şi cinci de mii.
translations.grk: Ἔλεγε δὲ ἐπικαλούμενος τόνδε τὸν τρόπον, σὺ, Δέσποτα, ἀπέστειλας τὸν ἄγγελόν σου ἐπὶ Ἑζεκίου τοῦ βασιλέως τῆς Ἰουδαίας, καὶ ἀνεῖλες ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς Σενναχηρεὶμ εἰς ἑκατὸν ὀγδοηκονταπέντε χιλιάδας.

verses.translation: wherefore now also, O Lord of heaven, send a good angel before us for a fear and dread unto them;

translations.ron: Şi acum, Stăpânitorule al cerurilor, trimite înger bun înaintea noastră, care să fie spre frică şi spre cutremur,
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν, Δυνάστα τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἀπόστειλον ἄγγελον ἀγαθὸν ἔμπροσθεν ἡμῶν εἰς δέος καὶ τρόμον.

verses.translation: and through the might of thine arm let those be stricken with terror, that come against thy holy people to blaspheme. And he ended thus.

translations.ron: Ca de mărirea braţului Tău să se înfricoşeze cei care cu hulă vin asupra sfântului Tău popor". Şi aceste cuvinte i-au fost toată rugăciunea.
translations.grk: Μεγέθει βραχίονός σου καταπλαγείησαν οἱ μετὰ βλασφημίας παραγενόμενοι ἐπὶ τὸν ἅγιόν σου λαόν· καὶ οὗτος μὲν ἐν τούτοις ἔληξεν.

verses.translation: Then Nicanor and they that were with him came forward with trumpets and songs.

translations.ron: Nicanor şi cei care erau cu el, veneau cu trâmbiţe şi cu cântece.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ περὶ τὸν Νικάνορα μετὰ σαλπίγγων καὶ παιάνων προσῆγον,

verses.translation: But Judas and his company encountered the enemies with invocation and prayer.

translations.ron: Iar Iuda şi cei care erau cu el, cu chemare şi cu rugăciuni s-au luptat cu vrăjmaşii.
translations.grk: οἱ δὲ περὶ τὸν Ἰούδαν μετʼ ἐπικλήσεως καὶ εὐχῶν συνέμιξαν τοῖς πολεμίοις.

verses.translation: So that fighting with their hands, and praying unto God with their hearts, they slew no less than thirty and five thousand men: for through the appearance of God they were greatly cheered.

translations.ron: Şi cu mâinile oştindu-se, iar cu inimile rugându-se către Dumnezeu, au doborât treizeci şi cinci de mii, veselindu-se foarte mult de această măreaţă arătare a lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Καὶ ταῖς μὲν χερσὶν ἀγωνιζόμενοι, ταῖς δὲ καρδίαις πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν εὐχόμενοι, κατέστρωσαν οὐδὲν ἧττον μυριάδων τριῶν καὶ πεντακισχιλίων, τῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ μεγάλως εὐφρανθέντες ἐπιφανείᾳ.

verses.translation: Now when the battle was done, returning again with joy, they knew that Nicanor lay dead in his harness.

translations.ron: Iar încetând războiul şi cu bucurie întorcându-se, au cunoscut că Nicanor, îmbrăcat cu toate armele sale, a căzut.
translations.grk: Γενόμενοι δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς χρείας, καὶ μετὰ χαρᾶς ἀναλύοντες, ἐπέγνωσαν προπεπτωκότα Νικάνορα σὺν τῇ πανοπλίᾳ.

verses.translation: Then they made a great shout and a noise, praising the Almighty in their own language.

translations.ron: Şi făcându-se strigare şi vălmăşag, au binecuvântat pe Cel Puternic în graiul părinţilor.
translations.grk: Γενομένης δὲ κραυγῆς καὶ ταραχῆς, εὐλόγουν τὸν Δυνάστην τῇ πατρίῳ φωνῇ.

verses.translation: And Judas, who was ever the chief defender of the citizens both in body and mind, and who continued his love toward his countrymen all his life, commanded to strike off Nicanor's head, and his hand with his shoulder, and bring them to Jerusalem.

translations.ron: Şi a poruncit Iuda, cel care în tot chipul era gata cu trupul şi cu sufletul a muri pentru cetăţeni, şi din tinereţea sa a păzit bunăvoinţa către cei de o lege, ca să taie capul lui Nicanor şi mâna cu braţ cu tot şi să le aducă în Ierusalim.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσέταξεν ὁ καθʼ ἅπαν σώματι καὶ ψυχῇ πρωταγωνιστὴς ὑπὲρ τῶν πολιτῶν, ὁ τὴν τῆς ἡλικίας εὔνοιαν εἰς ὁμοεθνεῖς διαφυλάξας, τὴν τοῦ Νικάνορος κεφαλὴν ἀποτεμόντας, καὶ τὴν χεῖρα σὺν τῷ ὤμῳ φέρειν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

verses.translation: So when he was there, and had called them of his nation together, and set the priests before the altar, he sent for them that were of the tower,

translations.ron: Şi după ce a sosit acolo, chemând pe cei de o lege cu sine şi pe preoţi punându-i înaintea jertfelnicului, a chemat pe cei care erau în cetate.
translations.grk: Παραγενόμενος δὲ ἐκεῖ, καὶ συγκαλέσας τοὺς ὁμοεθνεῖς, καὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς πρὸ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου στήσας, μετεπέμψατο τοὺς ἐκ τῆς ἄκρας.

verses.translation: and shewed them vile Nicanor's head, and the hand of that blasphemer, which with proud brags he had stretched out against the holy temple of the Almighty.

translations.ron: Şi le-a arătat capul nelegiuitului Nicanor şi mâna celui rău hulitor, pe care cu semeţie o întinsese asupra casei celei sfinte a Atotputernicului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιδειξάμενος τὴν τοῦ μιαροῦ Νικάνορος κεφαλὴν, καὶ τὴν χεῖρα τοῦ δυσφήμου, ἣν ἐκτείνας ἐπὶ τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ παντοκράτορος οἶκον ἐμεγαλαύχησε.

verses.translation: And when he had cut out the tongue of that ungodly Nicanor, he commanded that they should give it by pieces unto the fowls, and hang up the reward of his madness before the temple.

translations.ron: Şi limba răului credincios Nicanor a poruncit să o taie şi să o facă bucăţi mărunte şi să o dea păsărilor; iar în faţa sfântului locaş, să spânzure braţul răufăcătorului.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὴν γλῶσσαν τοῦ δυσσεβοῦς Νικάνορος ἐκτεμὼν, ἔφη κατὰ μέρος δώσειν τοῖς ὀρνέοις, τὰ δὲ ἐπίχειρα τῆς ἀνοίας κατέναντι τοῦ ναοῦ κρεμᾶσαι.

verses.translation: So every man praised toward the heaven the glorious Lord, saying, Blessed be he that hath kept his own place undefiled.

translations.ron: Şi toţi căutând la cer, au binecuvântat pe Domnul Dumnezeu, zicând: Bine este cuvântat Cel care a păzit locul Său neîntinat.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ πάντες εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησαν τὸν ἐπιφανῆ Κύριον, λέγοντες, εὐλογητὸς ὁ διατηρήσας τὸν ἑαυτοῦ τόπον ἀμίαντον.

verses.translation: He hanged also Nicanor's head upon the tower, an evident and manifest sign unto all of the help of the Lord.

translations.ron: Capul lui Nicanor l-a spânzurat pe zidul cetăţii, ca să-l vadă toţi şi să cunoască cum că este adevărat semn al ajutorului lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Ἐξέδησε δὲ τὴν τοῦ Νικάνορος κεφαλὴν ἐκ τῆς ἄκρας, ἐπίδηλον πᾶσι καὶ φανερὸν τῆς τοῦ Κυρίου βοηθείας σημεῖον.

verses.translation: And they ordained all with a common decree in no case to let that day pass without solemnity, but to celebrate the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which in the Syrian tongue is called Adar, the day before Mardocheus' day.

translations.ron: Şi au hotărât toţi într-un cuget să nu lase neînsemnată ziua aceasta;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐδογμάτισαν πάντες μετὰ κοινοῦ ψηφίσματος μηδαμῶς ἐᾶσαι ἀπαρασήμαντον τὴνδε τὴν ἡμέραν· ἔχειν δὲ ἐπίσημον τὴν τρισκαιδεκάτην τοῦ δωδεκάτου μηνὸς, Ἄδαρ λέγεται τῇ Συριακῇ φωνῇ, πρὸ μιᾶς ἡμέρας τῆς Μαρδοχαϊκῆς ἡμέρας.

verses.translation: Thus went it with Nicanor: and from that time forth the Hebrews had the city in their power. And here will I make an end.

translations.ron: Ci serbarea ei să fie în ziua a treisprezecea a lunii a douăsprezecea, care în limba siriană se zice Adar, cu o zi mai înainte de ziua lui Mardoheu.
translations.grk: Τῶν οὖν κατὰ Νικάνορα χωρησάντων οὕτω, καὶ ἀπʼ ἐκείνων τῶν καιρῶν κρατηθείσης τῆς πόλεως ὑπὸ τῶν Ἑβραίων. Καὶ αὐτὸς αὐτόθι καταπαύσω τὸν λόγον.

verses.translation: And if I have done well, and as is fitting the story, it is that which I desired: but if slenderly and meanly, it is that which I could attain unto.

translations.ron: Deci cele ce au fost cu Nicanor aşa s-au întâmplat şi din vremurile acelea au stăpânit Evreii cetatea Ierusalimului; iar eu voi sfârşi aici cuvântul.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰ μὲν καλῶς καὶ εὐθίκτως τῇ συντάξει, τοῦτο καὶ αὐτὸς ἤθελον· εἰ δὲ εὐτελῶς καὶ μετρίως, τοῦτο ἐφικτὸν ἦν μοι.

verses.translation: For as it is hurtful to drink wine or water alone; and as wine mingled with water is pleasant, and delighteth the taste: even so speech finely framed delighteth the ears of them that read the story. And here shall be an end.

translations.ron: Şi de este bine întocmit şi cum se cuvine, aceasta şi eu am vrut; iar de este cu ponosuri şi de mijloc, eu unul am făcut tot ce am putut.
translations.grk: Καθάπερ γὰρ οἶνον καταμόνας πίνειν, ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ ὕδωρ πάλιν, πολέμιον· ὃν δὲ τρόπον οἶνος ὕδατι συγκερασθεὶς ἡδὺς, καὶ ἐπιτερπῆ τὴν χάριν ἀποτελεῖ, οὕτω καὶ τὸ τῆς κατασκευῆς τοῦ λόγου τέρπει τὰς ἀκοὰς τῶν ἐντυγχανόντων τῇ συντάξει· ἐνταῦθα δὲ ἔσται ἡ τελευτή.
